super6.race: BAR 1 Betting 'Bet 10 Get 50' Tara Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Useful hurdler at best, but made little impact over fences last season and well held in 3 starts since reverting to hurdling. Mark has eased as a result, though he has questions to answer at present.

super6.race: Oddschecker Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (Registered As The Tom Olliver Handicap Chase) (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Reappeared with a good third of 20 in listed handicap hurdle at the Galway Festival before making a winning return to chasing in 4-runner event at Fontwell last month under an attacking ride. Shapes as if he'll stay this far and remains unexposed as a chaser.
Well held in this last year after winning at Galway on return (only fifth in this year's renewal on comeback 3 weeks ago, finishing tired).

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Easy winner on second start in points. Looked a longer-term project in a pair of maiden hurdles in the spring.

finals.race: StoneX Commodities Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Strong in market when winning on second start for yard at Leicester (2m, soft) last November. Only 1 lb higher following mixed bag remainder of last season. Capable fresh and attractively handicapped if on song in refitted tongue strap. Stable going very well, too (35% strike rate last 5 weeks).

Impressive winner of only start in Irish points in March. Unable to land the odds on hurdling debut when third of 11 in novice at Ffos Las last month, though was unsuited by the lack of pace in the race. Could well leave his recent effort behind.

Shaped encouragingly on debut when finishing third behind a pair of above-average prospects in a Kempton bumper in March. However, after 7 months off he raced too freely when last of 6 in another bumper at Worcester 25 days ago. Difficult task now hurdling.

Shaped as if in need of the experience only start in bumpers, but made little impression sent hurdling after 6 months off when fourth of 9 in novice at Stratford 17 days ago. Looks to face a tough ask.

finals.race: WKD Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Point/hurdles winner on return last season. Pulled up in the EBF Novices' Final at Sandown on final outing last season but got right back on the up when winning a 4-runner handicap at Southwell (2m, good) on last month's chase bow, jumping soundly. Longer trip should suit and he can improve again.

finals.race: WKD Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Point runner-up who filled same position first 2 starts under Rules before finally building on that promise when scoring from the front in a 9-runner novice at Uttoxeter in March. Still appeals as one who should do better again over fences.

£240,000 4-y-o, third foal, dam unraced half-sister to fairly useful hurdler (stayed 23f) Western Honour. Won only outing in Irish points in February and moved to a powerful yard for big money after. Has to be of interest on Rules debut.
€10,000 4-y-o, Success Days filly. Dam unraced. Finished third on second of 2 starts in Irish points (Apr 2026) but went with no encouragement over C&D last month.

finals.race: BAR 1 Betting 'Bet 10 Get 50' Tara Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Useful hurdler at best, but made little impact over fences last season and well held in 3 starts since reverting to hurdling. Mark has eased as a result, though he has questions to answer at present.

Fair winner of a Fairyhouse claimer (1¼m) for Joseph O'Brien. In need of experience on yard/hurdles debut but fair form on both subsequent starts, latterly when fifth in listed Wensleydale Hurdle at Wetherby (2m) in October. Cheekpieces back on in place of blinkers and claims back down in class.

finals.race: Oddschecker Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (Registered As The Tom Olliver Handicap Chase) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Made great strides as a novice chaser last season when twice a winner at Kelso before an excellent second of 17 in National Hunt Chase at Cheltenham Festival (3¾m). Might have found Scottish Grand National coming too soon next time and easy to forgive comeback run at Perth. Better expected now.

finals.race: Oddschecker Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (Registered As The Tom Olliver Handicap Chase) (GBB Race)

finals.race: Maria's And Aidie's 25th Wedding Anniversary Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Runner-up only start in Irish points but little impact over hurdles, including when upped in trip on return/handicap debut at Fontwell (19f, good to soft) early last month. Too soon to be writing him off, however.

finals.race: Three Counties Christmas Open NH Flat Race (Listed) (Registered As The William Kidd) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Choeur Du Nord gelding who was well backed and made a winning start in good style in 12-runner bumper at Fontwell (2¼m, good) back in May, drawing clear final 1f. Yard in red-hot form and open to improvement, he's high on the shortlist.

finals.race: Three Counties Christmas Open NH Flat Race (Listed) (Registered As The William Kidd) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Order of St George gelding who finished runner-up only start in Irish points and belied market weakness in going one better in 5-runner bumper at Carlisle (17f, good to soft) last month, giving a yard its first ever winner in this sphere. Will need to step forward to get involved here.
